# Test custom template loading and rendering

# A template directory overrides embedded templates by DEFINED NAME, not by
# file name: the renderer executes "layout", so that is what a custom
# directory must define.
md2html -templates my-templates -http :9004 &
wait-port :9004

# Verify custom template is being used
curl -s http://localhost:9004/doc
stdout 'Custom Template Loaded'

# Test with non-existent template directory (should fall back to embedded)
md2html -templates nonexistent-dir -http :9005 &
wait-port :9005

# Should still work with embedded templates
curl -s http://localhost:9005/doc
stdout '<!DOCTYPE html>'

# Stop the script; the background server is terminated with it.
stop

-- doc.md --
# Test Document

This document tests custom template functionality.

-- my-templates/layout.html --
{{define "layout"}}
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <title>Custom Template Loaded</title>
</head>
<body>
    <h1>Custom Template Loaded</h1>
    {{.Content}}
</body>
</html>
{{end}}
